source_commit_message:
Expand Decoder.MaxTableNesting() to arrays, rename to MaxDepth()

It would limit the max depth of tables, but not arrays like:

	a = [[[ 1 ]]] # Well, many more obviously

So also apply it here. And rename to MaxDepth() as it now works for more
than just arrays. Also nicer and short.

Fixes #497
Closes #501
